description: This Java class 'DittoRejectionHandlerFactory' provides a factory method to create a custom Akka HTTP 'RejectionHandler' that handles missing query parameter rejections by returning a 400 Bad Request status with a formatted message.

classes.name: DittoRejectionHandlerFactory
classes.description: A utility factory class to create custom Akka HTTP rejection handlers for specific request rejection cases.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a custom RejectionHandler that handles missing query parameter rejections by returning a BAD_REQUEST status with a specific message.

methods.name: handleMissingQueryParam
methods.description: Handles MissingQueryParamRejection by returning a 400 Bad Request with a message indicating the missing parameter.
